<p>Sharpen achieved batch production of Ø400mm 1A1 cermet-bond diamond and CBN wheels, marking a milestone in domestic high-end wheel R&D. Sharpen successfully developed and put into batch production Ø400mm 1A1 cermet-bond diamond and CBN wheels for the market. Following the July 2013 development of cermet-bond vertical- and surface-grinding wheels (Ø300mm, 20mm thick) and October 2013 wheels for HSS, titanium and superalloys, the team developed the Ø400mm 1A1 wheels in November 2013 and began batch production in January 2014. This demonstrates Sharpen’s proprietary, full-process capability in high-performance cermet-bond diamond/CBN wheels and strong-grooving of HSS rotary bodies.</p>
